title: One dead, dozens injured and thousands evacuated in Croatian wildfires – as it happened
description:
Firefighters discover body and say more than 40 people hurt in the Lokva Rogoznica and Omiš areas

England has received just 4mm of rain so far in August, or 6% of the long-term average for the month, the Environment Agency said on Friday, as reported by PA.

It follows the driest July on record for the country, when only 7mm of rain was measured, or 10% of the average.
